figure1_primary_null_distributions.png.notes: All four split-role panels show the true statistic, pseudo-null distribution, q95 threshold, units, and pass/fail label without clipping.

figure2_layerwise_q_curves.png.notes: All four panels distinguish true taxonomy, pseudo median, q05-q95 interval, decoder block, and median log10 q; the block-24/25 boundary is visible.

figure3_true_minus_pseudo_heatmaps.png.notes: All split-role panels use one symmetric color scale and define red/blue through the colorbar as true minus pseudo-median log10 q.

limitations_checked: Figure 1 decides only the registered late-minus-early specificity rule.
Figure 2 shows non-monotonic layerwise trajectories and does not imply a shared cross-layer direction.
Figure 3 shows absolute taxonomy excess, not the primary late-minus-early contrast.
